title: 03. Agents from Scratch: What Actually Happens Inside an Agent?
summary: What Actually Happens Inside an Agent?: explanations and runnable examples.
objectives: What Actually Happens Inside an Agent?

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body:
```
MOST PEOPLE THINK AN AGENT WORKS LIKE THIS:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
  User asks question ──────────────────► Magic ──► Answer
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

REALITY — HERE IS EVERY SINGLE STEP:
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

  YOUR PYTHON CODE                    OPENAI SERVER
  ────────────────                    ─────────────

  1. You define Python functions       
     (calculator, weather, etc.)       
          │                            
          ▼                            
  2. You write JSON descriptions       
     of those functions                
     (TOOLS_SCHEMA)                    
          │                            
          ▼                            
  3. You build a messages list:        
     [ {role:system, content:...},     
       {role:user,   content:...} ]    
          │                            
          │  ── HTTP POST ──────────►  4. OpenAI reads:
          │                               - your messages
          │                               - your tool descriptions
          │                               - decides: use tool? or answer?
          │                            
          │  ◄─ HTTP response ──────── 5. Returns EITHER:
          │                               A) finish_reason="tool_calls"
          │                                  + which tool + what args
          │                               B) finish_reason="stop"
          │                                  + final text answer
          │
          ▼
  6. YOUR CODE checks finish_reason:
     
     If "tool_calls":
       - Find the Python function by name
       - Call it with the args OpenAI gave
       - Get the result
       - Append result to messages list
       - Go back to step 3 (loop!)
     
     If "stop":
       - Extract msg.content
       - Show to user
       - DONE ✅

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
THE ENTIRE AGENT IS JUST THIS LOOP.
FRAMEWORKS (LangChain etc.) JUST HIDE IT FROM YOU.
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
```

series: Deep Dive: AI Agent from Scratch
